# Collectron: Toxic Bob Collectron Station

__Toxic Bob Collectron Station__

*Let this Collectron gather some of that toxic stuff you’d rather not touch.*

__Overview__

The Toxic Bob Collectron Station sends out Toxic Bob to collect hazardous materials that most wastelanders would rather avoid.

__Function__

| **Item Produced** | **Drop Rate** |
| Dirty Water | *33%* |
| Glowing Blood Pack | 33% |
| Toxic Goo | 33% |

- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 Seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: All other Collectron Stations
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 5

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Copper
- 1x Gear
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 10 pounds of collected items

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop:
 - Toxic Bob Collectron Station: 700 Atoms
 - X Bundle: X Atoms (includes Toxic Bob Collectron Station)
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
